courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring instruments through transferable principles, measurements and validation; a link does not imply the same vendor, generation or acceptance requirements.

related.title: 分段鏡共相控制
related.transfer: 可遷移「基線、幾何延遲與角解析度」與「條紋追蹤、大氣活塞與相干時間」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；分段鏡共相控制的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Baseline, geometric delay and angular resolution" and "Fringe tracking, atmospheric piston and coherence time" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Segmented-mirror co-phasing control must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦VLTI 與 CHARA 延遲線、條紋追蹤與雷射計量如何把光程差控制在奈米等級；分段鏡共相控制則以段鏡 piston 誤差的光學代價、邊緣感測器與致動器、2π 模糊、共相相機、設定點校正與段鏡更換為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on how VLTI and CHARA delay lines, fringe tracking and laser metrology hold optical-path difference at the nanometre level; Segmented-mirror co-phasing control centres on optical cost of segment piston, edge sensors and actuators, 2π ambiguity, phasing cameras, set-point calibration and segment exchange, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「基線向量與幾何延遲」與「36 片六角段鏡的共相波前」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到分段鏡共相控制，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「感測器設定點校正與共相誤差預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Baseline vector and geometric delay” and “Co-phased wavefront of 36 hexagonal segments”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Segmented-mirror co-phasing control, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Sensor set-point calibration and the phasing error budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

courses.summary: 天文干涉儀光程控制：VLTI 與 CHARA 延遲線、條紋追蹤與雷射計量如何把光程差控制在奈米等級。
courses.summaryEn: Optical-path control in astronomical interferometers: How VLTI and CHARA delay lines, fringe tracking and laser metrology hold optical-path difference at the nanometre level.

courses.connectionEn: Trace the system from “Baseline vector and geometric delay” to “End-to-end acceptance and operations record”; the map gives public geographic context.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 天文干涉儀光程控制
history.text: 1920 年 Michelson 與 Pease 在威爾遜山以 6 m 干涉儀量出參宿四的角直徑；1974 年 Labeyrie 首次在兩台獨立望遠鏡之間取得星光條紋，證明分離望遠鏡的光程可以被控制。ESO 的 VLTI 於 2001 年取得首批條紋，延遲線隧道、雷射計量與條紋追蹤隨 AMBER、PIONIER 到 2016 年的 GRAVITY 逐步成熟，GRAVITY 在 2018 年以數十微角秒的天體測量追蹤銀河中心恆星 S2 通過近心點；喬治亞州立大學的 CHARA 陣列自 2005 年起以六台 1 m 望遠鏡與 331 m 基線運作，其真空光管與延遲線至今仍是可見光干涉的參考設計。
history.textEn: In 1920 Michelson and Pease measured the angular diameter of Betelgeuse with a 6 m interferometer on Mount Wilson, and in 1974 Labeyrie obtained the first stellar fringes between two independent telescopes, proving that the optical path between separate telescopes could be controlled. ESO's VLTI recorded its first fringes in 2001, and its delay-line tunnel, laser metrology and fringe tracking matured through AMBER and PIONIER to GRAVITY in 2016, which in 2018 tracked the Galactic-Centre star S2 through pericentre with astrometry at the tens-of-microarcsecond level; the CHARA Array of Georgia State University has operated six 1 m telescopes on a 331 m baseline since 2005, and its vacuum pipes and delay lines remain a reference design for visible-light interferometry.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「基線、幾何延遲與角解析度」到「端到端驗證、天體測量重複性與交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Baseline, geometric delay and angular resolution" through "End-to-end validation, astrometric repeatability and handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
